cds.title: University of Rhode Island Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025 entering class). International: 553 applied, 411 admitted (74%), 34 enrolled; overall admit rate 75%. 'Enrolled' is the C1 total of first-time, first-year students (3,431, full- plus part-time). GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11. SAT scores are submitted by only 23% of enrollees (test-optional); CDS lists ED (Nov 1) applicants 202 / admitted 150 in C21. Undergrad enrollment is B1 total undergraduates (14,466); intl_undergrads is the B1 total nonresident-alien undergraduates (178).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8: students are not required to submit standardized test scores; scores are used for placement and considered if submitted.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, 2026-27; room-only $9,470, board-only $5,600). CDS H6: only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 126 nonresident undergraduates received it, average $26,565. URI's international page says merit awards have historically ranged $8,750 to $15,000 per year (those are first-year awards; the H6 average covers all years and may include other awards).
